scope: Baseline delivery and restoration experiments; unsupported initial delivery is not evidence that context clearing broke a working PDF attachment

realModelPdfBlobBaseline.qualification: The first PDF probe incorrectly required a binary_asset event; the completed loopback probe corrected that assumption and verified persisted inline bytes instead.

interpretation: PDF blobs did not become native document inputs in the tested SDK/provider configurations, including before clearing.
The path-backed PDF route did not supply readable page content with tools disabled; attachment-by-path is not proof that the model receives its bytes.
A document-reading tool or a different model/provider/native-document configuration may work; those routes were not validated.
Do not generalize the successful PNG asset restoration to all PDFs, audio, video or omitted/expired assets.
